claim: Camera frames stay on this device; MoveMap sends no camera data or analytics off-origin.
where: landing facts, setup consent, privacy page, README
sandbox: fresh demo context with fake camera; record a sample, reset, export, and assert every request is same-origin and no cookies exist

claim: MoveMap works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; wait for service-worker control, set the context offline, reload, and assert the sample result remains usable

claim: A calibration supports up to three checkpoints with ten examples each and a 30-second replay.
sandbox: fresh /demo sample; assert three completed 10/10 checkpoints, complete the timed replay, and inspect the exported result

claim: JSON export contains labels, settings, thresholds, and numeric signatures, with no image or video payload.
where: landing facts, export result, privacy page, README
sandbox: fresh /demo sample; download and parse the JSON, reject media keys, and assert 352 finite values in a signature

claim: A profile stays in browser storage across reloads and can be reset; demo data never touches the real profile database.
where: setup recovery, privacy page, demo banner, README
sandbox: fresh /demo sample; create a partial calibration, reload it, reset the sample, and assert only the demo database exists

claim: Calibration, testing, safety information, and JSON export are free; Maker Pack is a one-time $12 purchase.
where: landing facts, Maker Pack section, terms, README
sandbox: fresh /demo sample; assert the free-core copy, exact price and one-time wording, and registered Sociobot checkout URL

claim: Maker Pack exports a JavaScript trigger helper using the calibrated hold and release settings.
where: Maker Pack section, exported result, README
sandbox: fresh /demo sample with a recorded valid Sociobot verification response; download the helper and assert its exported function and calibrated settings
